title: Forty Steps to the Boat
summary: A woman keeps a journal of the forty steps between her door and the last boat, and each page costs her a step she cannot take back.

beats.text: Page one. The last boat leaves at dawn. It is forty steps from my door.
Page two. Thirty-eight steps. A man stood where my next step should be.
Page three. I waited until he wandered off. Thirty-six steps.
Page four. I dropped my bag to run faster. I did not look back.
Page five. Twenty steps. I hid behind a pump as a crowd drifted past, humming.
Page six. Someone in the crowd was calling my name, kindly.
Page seven. My brother's voice. He had stayed behind in the flat.
beats.speaker: man

beats.text: Page eight. Ten steps. I covered my ears and walked through them.
Page nine. The captain handed me my own bag, and my brother's coat.
Page ten. He had followed my steps, only to be sure I arrived.
